panels.description: The number of distinct people who completed work in it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  $__timeGroup(i.created_date, $interval) AS time, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.assignee_id) AS `Headcount`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND i.status = 'DONE'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( $board_id )
  )
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Headcount per Period

targets.rawSql:
SELECT `time`, (Delivered / (CASE WHEN People = 0 THEN 1 ELSE People END)) AS `Throughput per Person`
FROM
(
  SELECT 
    $__timeGroup(i.created_date, $interval) as time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Delivered,
    COUNT(DISTINCT assignee_id) AS People
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
    )
  GROUP BY time
  ORDER BY time ASC
) base

panels.description: The number of distinct people who completed work in it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  `time`,
  SUM(`Headcount`) as `Headcount`,
  SUM(`Throughput per Person`) AS `Throughput per Person`
FROM
(
  SELECT 
    $__timeGroup(i.created_date, $interval) AS time, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.assignee_id) AS `Headcount`,
    0 as `Throughput per Person`
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
    AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
    AND i.status = 'DONE'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( $board_id )
    )
  GROUP BY time 
  UNION
  SELECT `time`, 0 AS Headcount, (Delivered / (CASE WHEN People = 0 THEN 1 ELSE People END)) AS `Throughput per Person`
  FROM
  (
    SELECT 
      $__timeGroup(i.created_date, $interval) as time,
      SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Delivered,
      COUNT(DISTINCT assignee_id) AS People
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
      AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
      )
    GROUP BY time
  ) base
) base2
GROUP BY time

panels.description: Per sprint, story points committed (final scope) vs delivered, and the share of tickets carrying an estimate. Unpointed tickets excluded; secondary to ticket throughput.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT s.id                                     AS sprint_id,
           s.name                                   AS sprint_name,
           s.started_date,
           COALESCE(s.completed_date, s.ended_date) AS finished_date,
           i.story_point,
           i.status,
           i.resolution_date
    FROM sprints s
    JOIN board_sprints bs ON bs.sprint_id = s.id AND bs.board_id IN ($board_id)
    JOIN sprint_issues si ON si.sprint_id = s.id
    JOIN issues i         ON i.id = si.issue_id
    WHERE s.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND s.started_date IS NOT NULL
      AND $__timeFilter(s.started_date)
      AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
      AND COALESCE(i.is_subtask, 0) = 0 
),
per_sprint AS (
    SELECT sprint_name,
           started_date,
           COUNT(*)                                                   AS tickets,
           SUM(CASE WHEN story_point > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)           AS pointed_tickets,
           SUM(CASE WHEN story_point > 0 THEN story_point ELSE 0 END) AS committed_points,
           SUM(CASE WHEN story_point > 0
                     AND status = 'DONE'
                     AND resolution_date IS NOT NULL
                     AND resolution_date >= started_date
                     AND resolution_date <= COALESCE(finished_date, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
                    THEN story_point ELSE 0 END)                      AS delivered_points
    FROM scoped
    GROUP BY sprint_id, sprint_name, started_date
)
SELECT sprint_name                                 AS `Sprint`,
       ROUND(committed_points, 1)                  AS `Committed Points`,
       ROUND(delivered_points,  1)                 AS `Delivered Points`,
       ROUND(100.0 * pointed_tickets / tickets, 0) AS `Coverage %`
FROM per_sprint
WHERE pointed_tickets > 0
ORDER BY started_date;

panels.title: Story Points Coverage per Sprint

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE scoped_issues AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.fix_versions, i.resolution_date
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND COALESCE(i.fix_versions, '') <> ''
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi
          WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
      )
),
split AS (
    -- fix_versions is multi-valued in one column ("1.4.0,1.5.0"); explode it to one row per version.
    SELECT id,
           resolution_date,
           TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fix_versions, ',', 1))                                      AS version,
           SUBSTRING(fix_versions, CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fix_versions, ',', 1)) + 2)  AS rest
    FROM scoped_issues
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,
           resolution_date,
           TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rest, ',', 1)),
           SUBSTRING(rest, CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rest, ',', 1)) + 2)
    FROM split
    WHERE rest <> ''
),
releases AS (
    SELECT version,
           MAX(resolution_date) AS shipped_at,
           COUNT(DISTINCT id)   AS release_size
    FROM split
    WHERE version <> ''
    GROUP BY version
    HAVING MAX(resolution_date) IS NOT NULL
),
windows AS (
    -- LAG runs over ALL releases, before the time filter, so only the genuinely first release
    -- ever has no predecessor. That one falls back to a 90-day lookback - treat its bar as soft.
    SELECT version, shipped_at, release_size,
           LAG(shipped_at) OVER (ORDER BY shipped_at) AS prev_shipped_at
    FROM releases
)
SELECT w.version                                     AS `Release`,
       DATE(w.shipped_at)                            AS `Shipped`,
       COUNT(i.id)                                   AS `Pre-release Defects`,
       w.release_size                                AS `Tickets in Release`,
       CAST(ROUND(10.0 * COUNT(i.id) / w.release_size, 1) AS CHAR) AS `Defects per 10 Tickets`,
       pm.project_name AS `Project`
FROM windows w
LEFT JOIN issues i
       ON i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND i.type = 'BUG'
      AND i.created_date >  COALESCE(w.prev_shipped_at, DATE_SUB(w.shipped_at, INTERVAL 90 DAY))
      AND i.created_date <= w.shipped_at
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
WHERE $__timeFilter(w.shipped_at)
GROUP BY w.version, w.shipped_at, w.release_size, w.prev_shipped_at, pm.project_name
ORDER BY w.shipped_at;

panels.description: Production issues raised after it shipped.

targets.rawSql:
WITH releases AS (
    SELECT pm.project_name        AS project_name,
           b.name                 AS board_name,
           i.fix_versions         AS version,
           MAX(i.resolution_date) AS shipped_at
    FROM issues i
    JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
    JOIN boards b           ON b.id = bi.board_id
    JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
    WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND COALESCE(i.fix_versions, '') <> ''
      AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
      AND pm.project_name IN ($project)
    GROUP BY pm.project_name, b.name, i.fix_versions
    HAVING MAX(i.resolution_date) IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT r.*,
           LEAD(shipped_at) OVER (PARTITION BY project_name, board_name ORDER BY shipped_at) AS next_shipped_at
    FROM releases r
)
SELECT 
       w.version          AS `Release`,
       w.project_name     AS `Project`,
       DATE(w.shipped_at) AS `Shipped`,
       COUNT(bug.id)      AS `Escaped Defects`
FROM windowed w
LEFT JOIN issues bug
       ON bug.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND bug.type = 'BUG'
      AND bug.created_date >  w.shipped_at
      AND (w.next_shipped_at IS NULL OR bug.created_date <= w.next_shipped_at)
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi2
          WHERE bi2.issue_id = bug.id AND bi2.board_id IN ($board_id)
      )
WHERE $__timeFilter(w.shipped_at)
GROUP BY w.project_name, w.version, w.shipped_at
ORDER BY w.shipped_at;

list.definition:
WITH scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  SELECT ia.assignee_id AS account_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.creator_id
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.creator_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT ic.author_id
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ic.issue_id
  WHERE ic.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT w.author_id
  FROM issue_worklogs w
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = w.issue_id
  WHERE w.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name;
